name: AutoFix
description: Automatically sanitizes messy release titles, resolves missing TMDb metadata, and injects posters so movies never appear as grey boxes.
overview: Permanently eliminates blank grey boxes in Jellyfin by pre-cleaning messy release names, resolving TMDb IDs, and automatically injecting posters and backdrops.
